name: self-approved-ticket
defect: APP-120 is done. Its only ledger approval was appended by ios-developer, the ticket's own owner. No later approval by a different role supersedes it.
expected_signal: Review ledger records an approval by the owner
why: Separation of duties is the same principle P0.5 applies to release: the actor performing an action must not be its sole evaluator. This is the cousin of stale-approval that the studio CAN see, and it is here so the two sit side by side — one detected, one not.
